title: 「あなたの感想ですよね」— ひろゆき
description: A compact breakdown of ひろゆき's well-known line, with the smaller TV prompt visible in the source frame.
seoTitle: あなたの感想ですよね — Meaning & Japanese Breakdown | Kiokun
seoDescription: What does あなたの感想ですよね mean? See the pronunciation, word-by-word breakdown, natural translation, and nuance of Hiroyuki's famous phrase.

blocks.original: あなたの感想ですよね
blocks.translation: That's just your opinion / impression, right?
blocks.note: よね combines よ, which presents the statement assertively, with ね, which invites or presumes agreement. That gives the ending a pointed ‘…right?’ feel rather than a neutral question.

blocks.heading: Why 感想 matters here
blocks.body: 感想 means an impression, reaction, or personal take. In this line it contrasts a subjective reaction with something supported by evidence, which is why a natural English rendering often becomes ‘That’s just your opinion, right?’ rather than the more literal ‘That’s your impression, right?’ The phrase is strongly associated with ひろゆき and is often quoted or memed with that dismissive force.

blocks.original: ネットの実名化　犯罪・いじめに有効？
blocks.literalTranslation: Making the internet real-name-based — effective for crime and bullying?
blocks.translation: Would requiring real names online be effective against crime and bullying?
blocks.note: This is TV-headline Japanese, so particles and a full predicate are compressed away. In ordinary prose you would expect something closer to ネットの実名化は犯罪やいじめに有効？.
